ROIProvenance: NEW representative crown interiors chosen only on unchanged web-courtyard; these are not reconstructed historical ROI coordinates.
acceptance: Each prelocked crown mean per-pixel HSL saturation native/web inclusive [0.85,1.15], unchanged original ±15% requirement.
method: Same Math.round rectangle start/extents; exclude B>R+12&&B>=G sky and maxRGB/255>.93&&delta<.08 white; mean per-pixel HSL saturation, full precision. Pillow RGB decode instead of browser Canvas; no resizing.

leftForegroundCrown.reason: Dense leaf interior of left foreground crown, above its bare trunk; bounded away from path, sky and facade.

middleForegroundCrown.reason: Dense central crown interior above branching trunks; excludes right facade, foreground path and sky.

rightForegroundCrown.reason: Dense right foreground leaf interior, below the crown silhouette gaps and above bare branches; avoids visible facade and sky.

geometryBoundary: Same camera/crown locations required. Independent retained shares and whole-frame review expose coverage differences; no ROI retuning or inferred blocker from failure.
